brief:
Technology has become a comprehensive security monitoring system targeting Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported. The system collects biometric data and facial images, analyzing them through algorithms to track and target individuals. The practice converts human identity into open intelligence files, violating privacy and enabling systematic surveillance.

The scope and mechanisms of the algorithmic surveillance extend beyond traditional security measures, transforming personal data into tools for monitoring and identification across Palestinian populations.
dek: Technology has become a comprehensive security monitoring system targeting Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Israeli authorities convert Palestinians into surveillance files via biometric data
